UDR.data_quality_note: UDR's D&A XBRL tag ('DepreciationAndAmortization') is mis-scoped (too small by ~20-25x) for most quarters outside 2025-09-2026-06; 37 of 53 reconstructed quarters were dropped as implausible. own_pct_5y/10y above are therefore based on only 14 clean months (2025-08 to now), NOT a true 5y/10y sample -- treat as low-confidence / directional only.
